verdict.rationale: Perplexity's mobile app docs mention a 'Voice' feature ('Instant, up-to-date answers whether you type or say it'), indicating voice input/output exists, but there's no evidence describing a natural, continuous, real-time back-and-forth voice conversation mode (like a dedicated voice-chat UI) or its quality/latency. Missing for 10: details on conversational turn-taking, interruption handling, voice mode UX specifics, and independent hands-on validation of voice conversation quality.
